goal: Integrate the frozen dual-XGMII HFT baseline with the frozen RMIC M5.4 transactional core without modifying either upstream, while closing TAIFEX futures accounting, execution idempotency, safety-policy, timing, and end-to-end validation gaps.
handoff: I3 is complete. Frozen-HFT order mapping/policy, atomic futures reservation plus real-AMU order-context insertion, deterministic rollback/fault escalation, byte-identical accepted payload, and 156.25 MHz U50 OOC timing closure are verified at their stated evidence layers.
next_action: Merge PR #2, create I4, and insert the closed I3 risk gate into a new integration-owned wrapper around the frozen HFT order_data to TMP R01 path without modifying the HFT submodule.

tasks.title: Implement atomic normalized CL2EX admission controller
tasks.acceptance: Policy/accounting rejects do not create order context; accepted orders commit reserve plus AMU insert; duplicate/full insert failures release the exact reservation; rollback failure is fail-closed and never accepts.

tasks.title: Build frozen-HFT 256-bit futures risk order gate
tasks.acceptance: Account/product mapping, Side translation and configurable policy are fail-closed; accepted result payload is bit-for-bit identical to the frozen HFT input payload.

tasks.title: Close CL2EX functional atomicity and fault regressions
tasks.acceptance: Self-checking CI covers policy no-mutation, successful commit, duplicate/full rollback, margin reject, downstream result backpressure, mapping/policy failures, normalized context fields and injected rollback failure.

tasks.title: Measure atomic CL2EX gate with real pinned AMU on U50
tasks.acceptance: Vivado 2022.1 OOC composition at 6.400 ns uses real block RAM, fully routes with zero routing errors, WNS >= 0 and TNS = 0, with utilization/critical-path/DRC/power evidence reviewed.

tasks.title: Insert the closed risk gate into the frozen HFT R01 datapath
tasks.acceptance: Risk-rejected orders cannot reach R01; accepted R01 payload bytes remain identical to the frozen-HFT baseline; committed execution feedback shares state/store ownership safely.

milestones.summary: HFT and RMIC upstreams pinned as read-only submodules at frozen pre-integration baselines.
Order field mapping and fail-closed policy shell established with integration-level reject namespace.
Futures accounting v1 separates long/short and OPEN/CLOSE semantics using a host-configured margin-per-contract research model; not a TAIFEX SPAN claim.
Integration-owned R02/R32 fixed-offset tap captures PositionEffect and before_qty fields missing from the frozen HFT decoder; mutation authority remains external committed-report ownership.
LOB-inspired phase governance adopted: canonical project state, append-only decisions, living ExecPlan, one phase branch/PR, evidence-layer boundaries and mechanical governance CI.
Multi-account/product futures state manager regression closed key isolation, OPEN/CLOSE long/short semantics, margin reject, fail-closed ownership, configuration priority and reset recovery.
A 96-bit futures order context keyed by order_id reuses the frozen RMIC AMU contract without reusing stock-like account accounting.
Committed R02/R32 and R03 reconciliation passes partial/final fill, terminal release, cancel, reduce, replay/stale fail-closed and release-once scenarios.
Real-AMU I2 U50 OOC closes at 156.25 MHz after structural state/margin pipelining: routed WNS +1.078 ns, TNS 0, 3396 LUT, 2383 FF, 19 RAMB36 + 1 RAMB18, 10 DSP and zero routing errors.

Atomic CL2EX admission regression proves policy/accounting no-mutation, successful reserve+insert, duplicate/full rollback, stable result backpressure and no leaked reservation after recoverable store failure.
Fault injection proves an admission rollback failure can never accept an order and is escalated to an explicit recovery-required system failure.
Frozen-HFT order-gate regression closes exact account/product mapping, Side translation, mapping/policy fail-closed behavior, normalized context correctness and byte-identical accepted payload.

Real-AMU I3 atomic CL2EX U50 OOC closes at 156.25 MHz: synth WNS +3.023 ns, routed WNS +1.583 ns, TNS 0, 2392 LUT, 2693 FF, 11 RAMB36 + 1 RAMB18, 10 DSP, zero routing errors, and the worst path remains inside the frozen AMU.
